# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Publish the navigation API and opt-in ordinary Markdown discovery used by portable documentation shells and CLI starters.

## 0.1.0

### Added

- Framework-independent Markdown and MDX compiler conventions, including GFM, YAML frontmatter, heading slugs, and table-of-contents extraction.
- Configurable content source discovery, page metadata, navigation trees, and route generation.
- Optional Vite registry integration with eager, lazy, and metadata-only virtual modules.
- Build-time heading extraction and internal-link validation for Markdown and MDX pages.
- Optional compiled frontmatter exports and consumer-provided syntax highlighting.
